display_title: Do or Die: How the Madam Awakens
description:
When her husband passes away, So-Jin is left behind as a young widow with her prestigious in-laws. Pressured into maintaining her chastity, So-Jin lives a quiet life as a loyal daughter-in-law. That is, until she wakes up to a mysterious warning that she will die if she does not make sexual contact with the household’s newest farmhand, Woong-Sae. Left with a shameful mark on her forehead that proves this warning to be true, she takes action to save herself. Little does she know that Woong-Sae will awaken a whole new part of her along the way…

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.*
